main_claim: Fixed-budget assay design is multi-objective: predictive efficiency, measured-panel compression, true hidden-gene replacement and selector trade-offs are distinct evidence contracts.

panels.A: M1 Patch-seq fixed-budget benchmark; FSO beats PERSIST/random but is competitive, not superior, to sBNN at K25.
panels.B: Allen same-cell 2P+HCR independent measured replication; K5 improves four of five metrics at BH q<0.05, R2 directional q≈0.067.
panels.C: WARP measured-panel compression; compact measured panels retain much of full31 rank/classification information.
panels.D: Wang 2023 true hidden-gene replacement; selected true hidden genes outperform matched-random hidden genes in AUROC for all five targets.
panels.E: Bugeon selector/objective trade-off; no single selector is universally optimal across operator and shape objectives.

guardrails: Do not claim universal superiority over sBNN; K25 FSO and sBNN are statistically indistinguishable in current paired folds.
WARP compression is measured-panel compression, not true hidden-gene replacement.
Wang is the true hidden-gene replacement validation.
Allen HCR K21 full panel is a non-inferential baseline.
Prospective marker nomination is a separate tier from measured replacement.
